name: goroam-film
description: GoRoam product film: motion graphics in Remotion, voice, music and SFX by ElevenLabs.

scripts.render:film: remotion render Film-16x9 out/goroam-film-16x9.mp4 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p && remotion render Film-9x16 out/goroam-film-9x16.mp4 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:teaser: remotion render Teaser-16x9 out/goroam-teaser-16x9.mp4 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p && remotion render Teaser-9x16 out/goroam-teaser-9x16.mp4 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:all: npm run render:film && npm run render:web && npm run render:teaser && npm run finish
